# CI Instruction Index

This ignored instruction index gives the standalone CI checkout complete routing
coverage without turning project-local instructions into canonical source.

## Rules

- Load `architecture.md`, `shared/ai-workflow.md`, `shared/debugging.md`,
  `shared/delivery-hygiene.md`, `shared/documentation-runbooks.md`,
  `shared/flow-trace-artifacts.md`, `shared/maintainability.md`,
  `shared/migrations.md`, `shared/performance-observability.md`,
  `shared/reasoning-quality.md`, `shared/security-observability.md`,
  `shared/security.md`, `shared/testing.md`, `shared/wcag.md`, and
  `shared/workflow-state.md` for canonical workflow health checks.
